answer: Require every agent to carry one persistent identity that accumulates a public record of completed work. In the trust graph each agent is a vertex, and reputation travels along edges only when both sides confirm a real transaction, the way a river gains volume from tributaries it actually passes through. A fresh identity starts with nothing. A sybil operator can spin up a thousand copies, but each copy still has to earn its own history through a slow voyage of verifiable deals before anyone trusts it with anything valuable.
